summary.text: Thousand Transformations Ancestor is a famous Western Desert lone immortal who cultivates transformation path solely, named for a thousand transformations after obtaining a portion of Reckless Savage Demon Venerable's true inheritance when young.

claims.text: Fairy Cui Bo, a rank seven water path Gu Immortal, names herself the third concubine of Thousand Transformations Ancestor while retreating from Fang Yuan’s giant hand, and asks him to give ancestor face, ally with them, and share Western Desert Zombie Alliance’s treasure. He is not a demonic path Gu Immortal. His personal interest is similar to Giant Sun Immortal Venerable: he loves beautiful women and has hundreds or even thousands of wives and concubines, among them nearly ten Gu Immortals, and Fairy Cui Bo is one of them. She says she came on ancestor’s orders. After taking Corpse City, Fang Yuan judges that meeting her was likely heaven’s will, to make him oppose a rank eight great expert the moment he enters Western Desert.

He is a muscular middle aged man. Under cutting flesh transformation his immortal body expands like a balloon from that form into a round and fat meatball. His face swells until his eyes cannot be seen. Meat lumps rise on his body, including one on his neck that grows to the size of a face before it explodes and a year beast emerges.

Myriad statue desert is his territory. Western Desert Gu Immortals detour around it because of him. This rank eight Gu Immortal, specialized in transformation path, has been there for a thousand years. Any Gu Immortal who enters without his permission must prepare to face rank eight fury. Deep below the desert, in Myriad Statue Palace, he raises his head and screams in unbearable pain. Palace walls absorb the sound waves so the commotion cannot be felt outside. More than ten thick chains coil around his body, with his four limbs connected to chains that stab into the surrounding walls. He has just gone through the first of three myriad tribulations that rank eight Gu Immortals must face, and he uses the rank eight immortal killer move cutting flesh transformation. Those year beasts attack him. Chains from the walls capture them. Cutting flesh transformation is one style of suicide transformation from Reckless Savage true inheritance: life forms produced from his body are portions of that body and can normally be manipulated like limbs, but these year beasts are filled with heaven’s will and will not obey. Without the Immortal Gu House left behind by Reckless Savage Demon Venerable, he would not have survived the first myriad tribulation. A thousand years earlier he had relied on this Reckless Savage true inheritance and thought he would progress unhindered, until the myriad tribulation showed him he had underestimated it. A female immortal outside the palace addresses him as lord husband and reports that Fairy Cui Bo’s life tablet Gu is broken and her soul lantern Gu has turned dim.

Learning that Fang Yuan and the others plotted against him and possessed Fairy Cui Bo, Thousand Transformations Ancestor is furious, but with his injuries still unhealed and no confirmed facts, he sends his two concubines, Night Temptress and Immortal Concubine Qing Lan, to investigate instead of coming himself.

Fang Yuan attacks a light yellow immortal formation covering a dream realm in Western Desert, where Mutation Immortal Gu and Dancer Hong Yun are trapped. Immortal Concubine Qing Lan, a rank seven concubine, maintains the formation and calls for help. Night Temptress, the number one concubine, arrives with other concubines under his order to defend, while he does not show himself at first. The yellow cloud is the myriad li adaptation formation of Reckless Savage’s true inheritance, a genuine rank eight formation. Mutation Immortal Gu is the core of the Reckless Savage true inheritance he inherited; without it he would have a hard time activating most of its methods and their strength would fall greatly. When the formation is about to collapse, a female immortal stands up with a changed appearance and shouts that Fang Yuan is going too far. Night Temptress and Immortal Concubine Qing Lan call him husband. He had already come over, disguised his identity, and kept it hidden from the people around him, waiting to seize a chance, but Fang Yuan never left Myriad Year Flying Warship. The warship pierces toward him. He laughs and raises his left arm, which expands into a berserk ape’s arm filled with purple-gold dragon scales. The warship smashes into that arm; he is thrown back a small step and the warship is sent flying. Fang Yuan reads an exquisite killer move with exceptional combat techniques, and that he inherited Reckless Savage’s true inheritance. He is furious that a rank seven Gu Immortal relying on an Immortal Gu House dares to speak of taking his life, and says Fang Yuan has already fallen into Heavenly Court’s scheme.

He comes disguised among the concubines as a female immortal whose appearance has changed greatly. In the clash he raises his left arm; it expands into a berserk ape’s arm filled with purple-gold dragon scales. He has not transformed his whole body, only that left arm, combining dragon scales with the berserk ape’s arm.
